# resistant atlas

> Resistant Atlas is an ongoing research and design project by Badriyah Alsalem that studies how pre-modern Arab knowledge systems translated the environment into language, orientation, and time.

## Pages

- [resistant atlas](https://resistantatlas.com/): Resistant Atlas is an ongoing research and design project by Badriyah Alsalem that studies how pre-modern Arab knowledge systems translated the environment into language, orientation, and time.
- [i. Introduction](https://resistantatlas.com/i-introduction): Resistant Atlas is an ongoing research and design project by Badriyah Alsalem that studies how pre-modern Arab knowledge systems translated the environment into language, orientation, and time.
- [ii. The Beginning](https://resistantatlas.com/ii-the-beginning): The kickoff of the research was understanding that humans are really not that imaginative.
- [iii. The Manifesto](https://resistantatlas.com/iii-the-manifesto): Prior to embarking on this project, I had a set of beliefs that I knew were the pillars of what I wanted to eventually undertake.
- [iv. Method](https://resistantatlas.com/iv-method): To uncover lost temporal realities, spatial frameworks, and environmental logics, it would be counterintuitive to rely solely on the tools and lenses of the present day.
- [v. Essays](https://resistantatlas.com/v-essays): The following chapters include essays that supplement and support the research of Resistant Atlas.
- [va. Inaccurate? Even better.](https://resistantatlas.com/vb-inaccurate-even-better): In the diagrams for the Resistant Atlas: Names of the Sun, the tilt of the summer vs. winter axes is not accurate to how the sun actually “moves” astronomically.
- [vb. Foucault’s Blind Spot](https://resistantatlas.com/va-foucaults-blind-spot): This raises the question: can Foucault’s model be applied to non-Western contexts?
- [1. Names of the Sun](https://resistantatlas.com/1-names-of-the-sun): The sun has different names based on where it is in the sky, which season, what time of day, its angle, intensity, behavior, how it is perceived, whether a friend, or an enemy.
- [Names of the Sun: Introduction](https://resistantatlas.com/1a-introduction): The sun has different names based on where it is in the sky, which season, what time of day, its angle, intensity, behavior, how it is perceived, whether a friend, or an enemy.
- [Names of the Sun: Approach](https://resistantatlas.com/1b-approach): From the 42 words for the sun I found in Kitāb al-Anwāʾ, I conducted a process to make these words computationally legible, to lay the groundwork for future digital tools.
- [Names of the Sun: Prototypes](https://resistantatlas.com/1c-prototypes): Names of the Sun manifested into different digital tools, a book, and physical artifacts.
- [Names of the Sun: Interactive Installation](https://resistantatlas.com/1d-interactive-installation): Names of the Sun, 2026. Frosted acrylic, brushed stainless steel, projection, sound. Continuum, Diriyah Art Futures (DAF), Riyadh, September 4 – November 14, 2026.
- [Names of the Sun: Triennial Activations](https://resistantatlas.com/1e-triennial-activations): Documentation of Resistant Atlas’s activations at the Sharjah Architecture Triennial 03 (2026–27).
- [2. Houses of the Moon](https://resistantatlas.com/2-houses-of-the-moon): Houses of the Moon is a study of lunar stations, or where the moon seems to mark the night sky, and the intricate environmental logic they chart over time.
- [Houses of the Moon: Introduction](https://resistantatlas.com/2a-introduction): Houses of the Moon is a study of lunar stations, or where the moon seems to mark the night sky, and the intricate environmental logic they chart over time.
- [3. Bodies of the Clouds](https://resistantatlas.com/3-clouds): Bodies of the Clouds is a study of how the names of the clouds held meteorological significance, embedded within the beauty of their descriptions.
- [Bodies of the Clouds: Introduction](https://resistantatlas.com/3a-introduction): Bodies of the Clouds is a study of how the names of the clouds held meteorological significance, embedded within the beauty of their descriptions.
- [4. Paths of the Wind](https://resistantatlas.com/4-paths-of-the-wind): Paths of the Wind, the fourth chapter of Resistant Atlas: coming soon.
- [Field Notes](https://resistantatlas.com/4-field-notes): I’m in Al Gharameel desert. This spot, these stars, feel like home.
- [Sources](https://resistantatlas.com/5-resources): Sources and further reading for Resistant Atlas.
- [Acknowledgments](https://resistantatlas.com/7-acknowledgments): I have met extraordinary people who gave me more than I could ever return: guidance, criticism, belief, and patience.
- [Contact](https://resistantatlas.com/8-contact): Contact Badriyah Alsalem: b@rummastudio.com, @awathe8 on Instagram, RUMMA Studio.

## Author

Badriyah Alsalem, architect and researcher, Kuwait. Practice: RUMMA Studio (https://rummastudio.com). Contact: b@rummastudio.com.
